title: API N+1 query storm
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the API as the faulty component, notes the inefficient logic introduced by the deploy, and attributes the issue to the 2.3.2 release.
root_cause: The API was deployed to version 2.3.2 at 10:20 this morning; the new product‑listing refactor introduced inefficient logic that makes each GET /api/products request take ~3 seconds, while the database and disks remain healthy.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced an N+1 query pattern in the product listing: it fetches products with one query, then issues a separate query for each product's category and stock, overwhelming the database with thousands of tiny queries per page load.
